svg.title: Chaos-to-Model at a glance
svg.desc: Four measurements on the same 12 files. A scanned 310-page Korean guide: c2m extracted 203,577 characters, Unsloth refused the upload, NeMo Curator extracted 309. Hangul characters on 28 scanned pages: c2m 4,337, Unsloth 162, NeMo Curator 162. Table rows kept in 8 Korean PDFs: c2m 6,727, Unsloth 4,622, NeMo Curator 0. Generated questions in the passage's own language: c2m 100%, Unsloth 92.6%, NeMo Curator 29.7%.
